content: FlexrayCluster Pdu Router interaction The following con- dition applies only in case of FlexRay on the same FlexrayCluster if two PduTrig- gering s refer to the same Pdu : this Pdu shall only be sent once to the FlexRay Inter- face. In other words the Pdu Router sends only one Pdu Transmission request to the FlexRay Interface.
